_comment: oh-my-herdr default: Claude Code leads; workers are Claude Code or senpi on OpenCode Go.
Copy to ~/.config/oh-my-herdr/config.json (global) or <project>/.omh/config.json (per project) and edit.
profiles.<name>.agent picks a launch definition (assets/agents.json, or "agents" below); args go to that agent's CLI.
family is used so a reviewer never shares a model family with the code it reviews.
agent "subagent" runs a Claude Code subagent of the lead instead of a pane: no startup wait, but only Claude models,
the lead's quota and permissions, and it ends with the lead. model: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or id; subagent_type:
general-purpose, Explore or Plan (both read-only: their final reply is the report), or a plugin's agent.
backend: where pane workers run. auto = herdr panes inside herdr, else herdr-core (hc) terminals; herdr; hc. See docs/configuration.md.
Model IDs come from senpi's model registry (Nov 2026) — check with `senpi --list-models opencode-go`.
